newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Ergo cuts NZ 2 and 3-yr fixed rates to 8.65 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ergo cuts NZ 2 and 3-yr fixed rates to 8.65 pct.

text.p: AMP Society's telephone banking subsidiary Ergo said on Tuesday it was cutting its two and three-year fixed home lending rates to 8.65 percent from 8.90 percent and 8.75 percent respectively.
AMP said it was cutting its one-year capped rate to 9.0 percent from 9.5 percent. The changes are effective immediately.
Managing Director Graham Meyer said the cuts reflected the current fall in wholesale rates.
He said Ergo continued to review its floating rate daily and would continue to take all its rates lower if the market permitted. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
